cross_verification.note_en: PNG's official 'Immigration & Entry Permit Information Handbook 2025' and 'Visa Information Guide' (both ica.gov.pg, directly fetched) require a photo for several visa classes but only describe it in generic terms - e.g. the Work Visa checklist asks for 'Two recent, clear and colour passport size photographs' and Permanent Residence classes ask for 'A current passport photo' - without restating exact mm/background specs in the visa document itself. The PNG passport checklist (same authority, ICA) specifies 45x35mm/white for passport photos, but since the visa documents do not explicitly restate this figure, size/background are left unverified here rather than assumed.
